title: MySQL 8.4 — Production Overview
description: Operator overview for multi-target MySQL 8.4 telemetry. Panels read catalog-approved v2 series from ADX, so the view is identical for Premium SSD v1 and Premium SSD v2.

query.query: MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId != 'verify-probe' | summarize by TargetId | order by TargetId asc

panels.title: Collector heartbeat
panels.description: Seconds since the collector last reported. A dead collector flatlines every other panel, and a flatline looks exactly like a healthy idle server — so this panel comes first.

targets.query:
CollectorHealth(90d)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| project TargetId, SecondsSinceLastBeat

MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.global_status' and Field == 'Threads_connected'
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Value) by TargetId
| project TargetId, Connected = Value

panels.title: InnoDB buffer pool hit ratio
panels.description: 1 - (reads from disk / logical read requests). Sustained dips below 99% on a gaming workload usually mean the working set no longer fits in the buffer pool.

targets.query:
let reads = MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo) | project Timestamp, TargetId, DiskReads=Rate;
let requests = MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo) | project Timestamp, TargetId, Requests=Rate;
reads
| join kind=inner requests on Timestamp, TargetId
| where TargetId in ($target_id) and Requests > 0
| extend HitRatio = 1.0 - (DiskReads / Requests)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, HitRatio) by TargetId
| project TargetId, HitRatio

MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.global_status' and Field == 'Slow_queries'
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Value) by TargetId
| project TargetId, SlowQueries = Value

panels.title: Throughput (queries/sec)
panels.description: Derived at query time from the cumulative Queries counter. Negative deltas from a server restart are dropped here, but remain visible in the raw table.

targets.query:
MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Queries', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| project Timestamp, TargetId, QPS=Rate
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Connections and threads
panels.description: Threads_running is the saturation signal; Threads_connected only counts open sessions. A pool that stays connected but stops running work shows up as a gap between the two.

targets.query:
MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| where Measurement == 'mysql.global_status' and Field in ('Threads_connected', 'Threads_running', 'Threads_cached', 'Max_used_connections')
| project Timestamp, Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Field), Value
| order by Timestamp asc

union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_rows_read', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_rows_inserted', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_rows_updated', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_rows_deleted', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo))
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| project Timestamp, Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Field), Rate
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Connection errors (per sec)
panels.description: Aborted_connects counts failed handshakes — with require_secure_transport=ON, a client missing TLS config lands here rather than in the error log.

targets.query:
union
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Aborted_connects', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)),
  (MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Aborted_clients', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo))
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| project Timestamp, Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Field), Rate
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Error log (performance_schema.error_log)
panels.description: Azure Flexible Server publishes no error-log diagnostic category, so Layer 1 cannot supply this at all. These rows exist only because the collector reads the ring buffer directly.

targets.query:
let selectedTargets = MysqlTelemetry
| where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId in ($target_id)
| summarize by TargetId, Host;
MysqlEvents
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| join kind=inner selectedTargets on Host
| project Timestamp, TargetId, Level, ErrorCode, Subsystem, Message
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 200
